annotations.text: The dropdowns on this artboard are live. Change one and the preview table below reshapes, the counters update, and mapping the same field twice trips a conflict state.
Reading order is the adoption path: import a career's history, see it totalled, find out if you're legal, then keep it current.

Replaces the untouched Tailwind Plus dashboard shell. A denser 240px rail (not the template's 288px), with a sidebar opportunity the old shell didn't have: an at-a-glance currency status card, pulling the same next-deadline computation as the Currency page.
